name: Ferienwohnung Pendlingblick
beschreibung:
Sunnily and quietly perched on a hillside above the Thiersee valley, Ferienwohnung Pendlingblick boasts unobstructed views of Mount Pendling. The well-kept apartment features bright interiors, a fully equipped kitchen, and a panoramic balcony.

Lake Thiersee for summer swimming and scenic hiking trails to alpine pastures are reached in minutes.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Pendlingblick in Thiersee offers sweeping mountain panoramas and restful living comfort in Kufsteinerland.
